nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How many firms embraced the strategy of designing products that were easy-to-maintain, repair, or refurbish?
nodes.answer: Only two firms mentioned designing products that were easy-to-maintain, repair, or refurbish among the companies studied for promoting sufficient consumption.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Green product design|Repairable product design_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How does the concept of repair contribute to the durability and longevity of products?
nodes.answer: Repairing faulty or broken products helps extend their lifespan, enhancing durability and longevity, which aligns with eco-design requirements for sustainable products.
